Poller "{{ .Values.poller.name }}" (id {{ include "centreon-poller.id" . }}) deployed as StatefulSet {{ include "centreon-poller.fullname" . }}.

gorgone connects to {{ ternary "wss" "ws" .Values.central.ssl }}://{{ .Values.central.host }}:{{ .Values.central.port }}{{ trimSuffix "/" .Values.central.baseUri }}/gorgone/pullwss/websocket
  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} logs {{ include "centreon-poller.fullname" . }}-0 -c gorgone

centengine crash-loops until the central exports its configuration: check the
poller's broker output host in Centreon, then export the poller configuration
(generate + move + restart). The restart back-off can delay the pickup by up
to 5 minutes: `kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} delete pod {{ include "centreon-poller.fullname" . }}-0` applies it at once.
